Subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Receipt of Letter of Acceptance of 
Tender from Thiruverkadu Municipality. 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and other applicable Regulations of the SEBI (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that M/s. 
Sattva Engineering Construction Limited along with M/s. JSR Infra Developers private 
Limited has received Letter of Acceptance of Tender (LOA)/Bagging of Contract from 
Thiruverkadu Municipality. 
Project: “DESIGN, ENGINEERING, BUILD AND COMMISSIONING OF 46 MLD 
CAPACITY SEWAGE TREATMENT PLANT AT KOLADI WITH SEQUENTIAL BATCH 
REACTOR (SBR) INCLUDING OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE FOR 10 YEARS 
AT THIRUVERKADU.” 
Contract  Value: 108,40,21,646/- (Excluding GST) (Rupees One Hundred and Eight 
Crore Forty Lakhs Twenty-One Thousand Six Hundred and Forty-Six Only)  
 
The details as per SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/PoD2/P/0155 dated 
November 11, 2024, read with SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD-
2/P/CIR/P/2024/185 dated December 31, 2024, are appended herewith as 
“ANNEXURE A”. 
 
The Company received the Award of Contract by Thiruverkadu Municipality by hand at 
5:12 p.m. on June 12, 2026, referencing Tender Notice No. 2422/2024/E1. 
Kindly take our above-referred disclosure on your record. 
For Sattva Engineering Construction Limited
